title: Emergent Reasoning in Large Language Models: A Survey
summary: This paper surveys recent advances in emergent reasoning capabilities observed in large language models (LLMs). We examine chain-of-thought prompting, tool use, and self-reflection mechanisms that enable LLMs to solve complex multi-step problems. Our analysis covers 50+ papers from 2022-2024 and identifies key patterns in how reasoning emerges with scale.

review.reason: Survey of chain-of-thought, tool use, and self-reflection in emergent LLM reasoning.
